newsitem.title: FRANCE: British teenage girl dies in French bus crash.
newsitem.headline: British teenage girl dies in French bus crash.

text.p: A 16-year-old British girl was killed and two people were seriously injured when a bus veered off a road in eastern France on Monday, a spokesman for the paramilitary gendarmes said.
Lieutenant-Colonel Bernard Belondrade said the bus left the road near the town of Moutiers and fell 20 metres (60 feet) into a ravine, eventually coming to rest on its side against a tree.
It was carrying 23 passengers from a nearby holiday camp to a rock-climbing site. The remaining 20 people were less seriously injured.

The identity of the victims, all from the northern British town of Bolton, and the cause of the accident were not immediately known. The gendarmes were due to question the driver, who was also from Britain.
Police had earlier said two people had died and three were seriously hurt.
